name: mule-engineering
description: Mule 4 engineering rules with verified examples: flows, layout, properties, the global error handler (a backend timeout is 504, never 408), structured logs and the build (mule-app); DataWeave modules and their tests (dataweave); the APIkit router and the spec it loads (apikit); MUnit tests that call each endpoint through the HTTP listener (munit); connectors, shared plugins and DataWeave libraries as versioned assets (mule-sdk).
